title: Full faithfulness of canonical finite etale descent
statement: Let g:Y' -> Y be a surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] map of schemes. Let F and q satisfy the pullback, transport-invariance and morphism equations of [lem-galois-descent-data-existence]. Then F is fully faithful: for every finite etale P,Q the map Hom(P,Q) -> Hom(F(P),F(Q)) is bijective.

source.place: Proof; corrected Stacks route recorded in node lem-galois-descent

proof.text: For each P the first projection q_P is a base change of g, hence surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation. Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Fpqc supplies EffectiveEpi q_P.

For any compatible morphism beta, transport and pullback uniqueness show beta followed by q_Q has equal values on points with the same q_P image. EffectiveEpi.desc gives a unique descended scheme map. Epimorphism cancellation proves it is over Y.
Construct the morphism of finite etale schemes from that map. Pullback uniqueness identifies its image with beta (fullness). Cancel q_P in the morphism equation to prove faithfulness.
